acceptance_criteria.criterion: independent_reviews() no longer fails the lwb-lanes gate solely because a STALE (or otherwise per-record-invalid) review record exists in reviews/<pr>/, PROVIDED a different, fresh, valid AGREE record already satisfies REQUIRED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEWS on its own. Proven by test_independent_reviews_passes_with_one_stale_and_one_fresh_valid_record, which asserts independent_reviews() returns True and errors == [] with one stale record and one fresh valid record present.

A record that does not count toward the requirement must still never COUNT -- a stale/invalid record can never itself satisfy REQUIRED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEWS, and when no OTHER valid record exists, its rejection reason must still surface in the errors that fail the gate. Proven by test_independent_reviews_still_fails_on_a_lone_stale_record: a lone stale record still fails independent_reviews() and the STALE message is present in errors.

The ordinary REQUIRED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEWS = 1, single-fresh-valid-record case (no stale records at all) is unaffected: still passes, still returns no errors, still emits no spurious notices. Proven by test_independent_reviews_ordinary_single_valid_record_still_passes.

_review_ok itself is untouched: same signature, same behavior, no weakening of the freshness check, the AGREE-verdict check, the reviewer_id != commit_author_id check, the segment-collision check, or the dispatched-boolean requirement. Proven by: (a) the diff touches only independent_reviews, not _review_ok; (b) every pre-existing test that calls _review_ok directly, including test_reviewable_head_still_rejects_stale_review_before_a_later_substantive_commit, is unmodified and still passes.
No regression anywhere else in the suite: python -m pytest tests/ -q passes in full (595 passed, up from 592 baseline + 3 new tests).

No vendored copy of scripts/lwb_lanes.py needs updating (it is a scripts/-only file, never vendored from core/ or adapters/), confirmed by `find plugins -iname '*lwb_lanes*'` returning nothing and python scripts/lwb_build.py --check passing for both plugins/claude/lwb/vendor and plugins/codex/lwb/vendor.
